grid.expression:
SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.DTENTSAI, CASE
WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE IS NULL AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' THEN '-----' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' THEN 'Aprovada' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'D' THEN 'Denegada' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'E' THEN 'Aguardando Autorização' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'I' THEN 'Enviada' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'M' THEN 'Não é NF-e' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'P' THEN 'Pendente de Retorno' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'R' THEN 'Aguardando Correção' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'S' THEN 'Enviada EPEC' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'T' THEN 'NF-e Terceiro' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'V' THEN 'Com erro de Validação' ELSE 'Não Enviada' END AS STATUSNFE, CAB.CODTIPOPER, CAB.CODNAT || ' - ' || (SELECT N.DESCRNAT FROM TGFNAT N WHERE N.CODNAT = CAB.CODNAT) AS CODNAT, TPO.DESCROPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, PAR.IDENTINSCESTAD, CASE WHEN PAR.SIMPLES = 'S' THEN 'Optante Simples' ELSE 'Não optante' END AS SIMPLES, OPTION_LABEL('TGFPAR','CLASSIFICMS',PAR.CLASSIFICMS) AS CLASSIFICMS, ITE.SEQUENCIA, ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.NCM, PRO.CODCTACTBEFD, (SELECT PLA.DESCRCTA FROM TCBPLA PLA WHERE PLA.CODCTACTB = PRO.CODCTACTBEFD) AS CONTA_CTB, ITE.QTDNEG, ITE.VLRUNIT, ITE.VLRTOT, ITE.VLRDESC, LIV.CODCFO, ITE.ORIGPROD, CASE WHEN NVL(LIV.DIGITADO,'N') = 'S' THEN LIV.CODTRIB ELSE ITE.CODTRIB END AS CODTRIB, CASE WHEN NVL(LIV.DIGITADO,'N') = 'S' THEN LIV.ALIQICMS ELSE ITE.ALIQICMS END AS ALIQICMS , ITE.CSTIPI, ITE.ALIQIPI, LIV.VLRCTB, LIV.OUTRASICMS, LIV.ISENTASICMS, LIV.OUTRASIPI, NVL(LIV.VLRCTB,0) - NVL(LIV.BASEIPI,0) - NVL(LIV.OUTRASIPI,0) - NVL(LIV.VLRIPI,0) AS VAL_IPI, LIV.ISENTASIPI, CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'C' THEN (NVL(ITE.VLRTOT,0) - NVL(ITE.VLRREPRED,0)) ELSE (NVL(ITE.VLRTOT,0) - NVL(ITE.VLRREPRED,0) - NVL(ITE.VLRDESC,0)) END AS VLREFD,
(SELECT SUM(LIV1.VLRCTB - LIV.ICMSRETENCAO - LIV.VLRIPI)
FROM TGFLIV LIV1
WHERE LIV1.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND LIV1.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA) AS VLRITELIQ,
CASE WHEN NVL(LIV.DIGITADO,'N') = 'N' THEN NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 1
AND DIN.CODINC IN (1,3,5)),LIV.BASEICMS) ELSE LIV.BASEICMS END AS BASEICMS, CASE WHEN NVL(LIV.DIGITADO,'N') = 'N' THEN NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 1
AND DIN.CODINC IN (1,3,5)),LIV.VLRICMS)
ELSE LIV.VLRICMS END AS VLRICMS,
(SELECT SUM(AJD.VLRICMS) FROM TGFAJD AJD WHERE AJD.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND AJD.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND AJD.CODOBSPADRAO <> 24 ) AS ICMS_AJUSTE,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASEDIFAL)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 1
AND DIN.CODINC IN (1,3,5)),0) AS BASEDIFAL,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VLRDIFALDEST)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 1
AND DIN.CODINC IN (1,3,5)),0) AS VLRDIFAL,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VLRFCP)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 1
AND DIN.CODINC IN (1,3,5)),0) AS VLRFCP,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 3
AND DIN.CODINC IN (1,3,5)),ITE.BASEIPI) AS BASEIPI,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 3
AND DIN.CODINC IN (1,3,5)),ITE.VLRIPI) AS VLRIPI,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 6),0) AS BASE_PIS,
NVL((SELECT MAX(DIN.CST)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 6),0) AS CST_PIS,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 6),0) AS VLR_PIS,
NVL((SELECT SUM(IDI.VLRPISIMP) FROM TGFIDI IDI WHERE IDI.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND IDI.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA) ,0) AS VLR_PISIMP,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 7),0) AS BASE_COFINS,
NVL((SELECT MAX(DIN.CST)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 7),0) AS CST_COFINS,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 7),0) AS VLR_COFINS,
NVL((SELECT SUM(IDI.VLRCOFINSIMP) FROM TGFIDI IDI WHERE IDI.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND IDI.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA) ,0) AS VLR_COFINSIMP,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASE)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 2),0) AS BASE_ST,
NVL((SELECT MAX(DIN.ALIQUOTA)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 2),0) AS ALIQ_ST,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 2),0) AS VLR_ST,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VLRFCPINT)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 2),0) AS VLR_FEM_ICMS_ST,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VLRFCPINT)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 1),0) AS VLR_FEM_ICMS_OP,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASE)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND (DIN.CODIMP = 6 AND DIN.CODINC = 3)),0) AS FRETE_ITEM,
NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASE)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND (DIN.CODIMP = 6 AND DIN.CODINC = 3)),0) - (NVL(LIV.VLRCTB,0) - NVL(LIV.BASEIPI,0) - NVL(LIV.OUTRASIPI,0) - NVL(LIV.VLRIPI,0)) AS DIF_VAL_IPI,
CID.NOMECID,
UF.UF,
CAB.CHAVENFE,
(SELECT MAX(C.NUMNOTA)
FROM TGFCAB C,
TGFVAR VAR
WHERE C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA
AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA
AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS NUMNOTA_DEVOLUCAO,
(SELECT MAX(I.VLRTOT)
FROM TGFCAB C,
TGFITE I,
TGFVAR VAR
WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA
AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA
AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA
AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA
AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRTOT_DEVOLUCAO,
(SELECT MAX(I.BASEICMS)
FROM TGFCAB C,
TGFITE I,
TGFVAR VAR
WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA
AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA
AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA
AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA
AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRBCICMS_DEVOLUCAO,
(SELECT MAX(I.VLRICMS)
FROM TGFCAB C,
TGFITE I,
TGFVAR VAR
WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA
AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA
AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA
AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA
AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRICMS_DEVOLUCAO,
(SELECT MAX(I.BASEIPI)
FROM TGFCAB C,
TGFITE I,
TGFVAR VAR
WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA
AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA
AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA
AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA
AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRBCIPI_DEVOLUCAO,
(SELECT MAX(I.VLRIPI)
FROM TGFCAB C,
TGFITE I,
TGFVAR VAR
WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA
AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA
AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA
AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA
AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRIPI_DEVOLUCAO
FROM TGFCAB CAB,
TGFITE ITE,
TGFPRO PRO,
TGFPAR PAR,
TGFTOP TPO,
TSICID CID,
TSIUFS UF,
TGFLIV LIV
WHERE LIV.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA
AND LIV.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND LIV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD
AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC
AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER
AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER
AND PAR.CODCID = CID.CODCID
AND CID.UF = UF.CODUF
AND TPO.ATUALLIVFIS <> 'N'
AND LIV.DHMOV >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND LIV.DHMOV <= :P_PERIODO.FIN
AND (CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL)
AND (CAB.NUNOTA = :P_NUNOTA OR :P_NUNOTA IS NULL)
AND (CAB.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTA OR :P_NUMNOTA IS NULL)
AND (CAB.CODTIPOPER = :P_CODTIPOPER OR :P_CODTIPOPER IS NULL)
AND LIV.CODCFO >= :P_CODCFOPINI
AND LIV.CODCFO <= :P_CODCFOPFIN
AND (ITE.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD OR :P_CODPROD IS NULL)
AND (CAB.CODPARC = :P_PARCEIRO OR :P_PARCEIRO IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT LIS.NUNOTA ,LIS.NUMNOTA ,CAB.DTNEG ,CAB.DTENTSAI ,'NF-e Terceiro' AS STATUSNFE ,CAB.CODTIPOPER ,CAB.CODNAT || ' - ' || (SELECT N.DESCRNAT FROM TGFNAT N WHERE N.CODNAT = CAB.CODNAT) AS CODNAT ,TPO.DESCROPER ,CAB.CODPARC ,PAR.NOMEPARC ,PAR.IDENTINSCESTAD ,CASE WHEN PAR.SIMPLES = 'S' THEN 'Optante Simples' ELSE 'Não optante' END AS SIMPLES ,OPTION_LABEL('TGFPAR','CLASSIFICMS',PAR.CLASSIFICMS) AS CLASSIFICMS ,LIS.SEQUENCIA ,PRO.CODPROD ,PRO.DESCRPROD ,PRO.NCM ,PRO.CODCTACTBEFD ,(SELECT PLA.DESCRCTA FROM TCBPLA PLA WHERE PLA.CODCTACTB = PRO.CODCTACTBEFD) AS CONTA_CTB ,ITE.QTDNEG ,ITE.VLRUNIT ,ITE.VLRTOT ,ITE.VLRDESC ,ITE.CODCFO ,ITE.ORIGPROD ,ITE.CODTRIB ,ITE.ALIQICMS ,ITE.CSTIPI ,ITE.ALIQIPI ,LIS.VLRCTB , 0 AS OUTRASICMS , 0 AS ISENTASICMS , 0 AS OUTRASIPI , 0 AS VAL_IPI , 0 AS ISENTASIPI , CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'C' THEN (NVL(ITE.VLRTOT,0) - NVL(ITE.VLRREPRED,0)) ELSE (NVL(ITE.VLRTOT,0) - NVL(ITE.VLRREPRED,0) - NVL(ITE.VLRDESC,0)) END AS VLREFD , ITE.VLRTOT AS VLRITELIQ , 0 AS BASEICMS , 0 AS VLRICMS , 0 AS ICMS_AJUSTE , 0 AS BASEDIFAL , 0 AS VLRDIFAL , 0 AS VLRFCP , 0 AS BASEIPI , 0 AS VLRIPI , NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 6),0) AS BASE_PIS
, NVL((SELECT MAX(DIN.CST)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 6),0) AS CST_PIS
, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 6),0) AS VLR_PIS ,0 AS VLR_PISIMP
, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 7),0) AS BASE_COFINS
, NVL((SELECT MAX(DIN.CST)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 7),0) AS CST_COFINS
, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR)
FROM TGFDIN DIN
WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
AND DIN.CODIMP = 7),0) AS VLR_COFINS ,0 AS VLR_COFINSIMP ,0 AS BASE_ST ,0 AS ALIQ_ST ,0 AS VLR_ST ,0 AS VLR_FEM_ICMS_ST ,0 AS VLR_FEM_ICMS_OP ,0 AS FRETE_ITEM ,0 AS DIF_VAL_IPI ,CID.NOMECID ,UF.UF ,CAB.CHAVENFE ,0 AS NUMNOTA_DEVOLUCAO ,0 AS VLRTOT_DEVOLUCAO ,0 AS VLRBCICMS_DEVOLUCAO ,0 AS VLRICMS_DEVOLUCAO ,0 AS VLRBCIPI_DEVOLUCAO ,0 AS VLRIPI_DEVOLUCAO FROM TGFLIS LIS
INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = LIS.NUNOTA AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = LIS.SEQUENCIA
INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON CAB.NUNOTA = LIS.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFTOP TPO ON TPO.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TPO.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER
INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC
INNER JOIN TSICID CID ON CID.CODCID = PAR.CODCID
INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD
INNER JOIN TSIUFS UF ON UF.CODUF = CID.UF
WHERE EXISTS( (SELECT DISTINCT LIS1.NUNOTA FROM TGFLIS LIS1 WHERE LIS.DTMOV >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND LIS1.DTMOV <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND LIS1.CODEMP IN (1,2) AND LIS1.ORIGEM <> 'F' AND ((LIS1.ORIGEM = 'E' AND LIS1.ENTSAI = 'E' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN D1 WHERE D1.NUNOTA = LIS1.NUNOTA AND D1.CODIMP IN (6,7) AND (((D1.VALOR <> 0 OR NVL(D1.VLRCRED,0) <> 0) AND D1.CST IN (49,50,51,52,53,54,55,56,60,61,62,63,64,65,66)) ))) OR (LIS1.ORIGEM = 'E' AND LIS1.ENTSAI = 'S' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN WHERE NUNOTA = LIS1.NUNOTA AND CODIMP IN (6,7))) ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT LIV.NUNOTA FROM TGFLIV LIV WHERE LIV.NUNOTA = LIS1.NUNOTA AND LIV.ORIGEM = LIS1.ORIGEM) AND LIS1.NUNOTA = LIS.NUNOTA AND LIS1.CODCFPS >= :P_CODCFOPINI AND LIS1.CODCFPS <= :P_CODCFOPFIN
) ) AND LIS.CODEMP IN (1,2) AND LIS.ORIGEM = 'E'
